professionalSummary.text: Delivers dispatch algorithm and interface work against mine operations specialists' specifications under the dispatch software standard.
professionalSummary.witness: Dispatch software engineer at a mining company from 2021 to 2025, delivering algorithm and interface work for the fleet dispatch system against the mine operations specialists' specifications under the dispatch software standard.

experienceHighlights.text: Carried the pager on the dispatch on-call rota for four years across three control rooms, with 52 night calls including 9 stopped-fleet incidents, each with time-to-restore and control room sign-off.
experienceHighlights.witness: Carried the pager on the dispatch on-call rota for the whole four years across the three control rooms; the on-call log lists fifty-two night calls under my name, nine of them stopped-fleet incidents, each with the time to restore and the control room's sign-off that the fleet was moving again.

experienceHighlights.text: Proved each change on the mine simulator before review, with simulator records filed against changes and countersigned by a second engineer.
experienceHighlights.witness: Every change of mine went through the mine simulator before review, with the simulator record filed against the change and countersigned by a second engineer.

experienceHighlights.text: Submitted changes through dispatch software review with releases approved by the dispatch software lead, as shown in change records.
experienceHighlights.witness: Changes went through dispatch software review and out on the dispatch software lead's approval, which the change record shows next to the checks that were mine.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented boundaries and hand-over notes in change records' closure sections for every change, stating what changes do not cover.
experienceHighlights.witness: Behind every change there is a boundary and hand-over note in the change record's closure section, stating what the change does not cover.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: On-call log pages for nine stopped-fleet incidents with control room sign-offs, and two change records with simulator records, review outcomes, lead approval, and change system references.

skills.text: Mine fleet dispatch system algorithm and interface development, simulator validation, change review, and boundary documentation.
skills.witness: Dispatch software engineer at a mining company from 2021 to 2025, delivering algorithm and interface work for the fleet dispatch system against the mine operations specialists' specifications under the dispatch software standard. Every change of mine went through the mine simulator before review, with the simulator record filed against the change and countersigned by a second engineer. Changes went through dispatch software review and out on the dispatch software lead's approval, which the change record shows next to the checks that were mine. role.roleTitle: Software Engineer, Mine Fleet Dispatch System

evidence.text: Dispatch software engineer at a mining company from 2021 to 2025, delivering algorithm and interface work for the fleet dispatch system against the mine operations specialists' specifications under the dispatch software standard.

Carried the pager on the dispatch on-call rota for the whole four years across the three control rooms; the on-call log lists fifty-two night calls under my name, nine of them stopped-fleet incidents, each with the time to restore and the control room's sign-off that the fleet was moving again.
Every change of mine went through the mine simulator before review, with the simulator record filed against the change and countersigned by a second engineer.
Changes went through dispatch software review and out on the dispatch software lead's approval, which the change record shows next to the checks that were mine.
Behind every change there is a boundary and hand-over note in the change record's closure section, stating what the change does not cover.
